text: Supports SSH key authentication using Ed25519, ECDSA, and RSA keys via libssh/libssh2
quote: Supports Ed25519, ECDSA and RSA keys. It is built on top of libssh and libssh2.

text: Keeps SSH/mosh sessions alive across network changes and device sleep
quote: You can flawlessly jump from home, to the train, and then to the office thanks to Mosh. Blink is rock-solid connected all the way.

text: Connections survive putting the device to sleep and waking it later
quote: don't be afraid to put your device to sleep, when you wake it up later, your connections will be intact.

text: Runs common local UNIX commands like cat, grep, ls, cp, rm, mkdir directly in the app
quote: cat, grep, wc, cd, setenv, ls, touch, cp, rm, ln, mv, mkdir, rmdir, df, du

text: Transfers files to/from remote hosts using scp and sftp
quote:
scp user@host.name.edu:filename . 
sftp localFilename user@host.name.edu:~/

text: Lets users customize terminal themes and fonts, including a bundled Pragmata Pro font
quote: You can rock your terminal and roll your own themes and fonts beyond our included ones. And yes, we include Pragmata Pro by default!

text: Supports Bluetooth keyboards with configurable key remapping (e.g. Caps as Esc, Cmd as Ctrl)
quote: Blink embraces Bluetooth-coupled keyboards with gusto. Some like Caps as Esc on Vim, others Cmd as Ctrl on Emacs. Blink champions them all.

text: Connects to VS Code for web, GitHub Codespaces, GitPod, or a self-hosted VS Code server for coding
quote: A coding experience fitted to your device, that connects to Microsoft Visual Studio Code for web, GitHub Codespaces, GitPod or your own VS Code server.

text: Blink Files lets users work on local projects or seamlessly on remote machines
quote: Work on local projects, or seamlessly on remote machines thanks to Blink Files.

text: Supports multiple simultaneous terminal shells created by tapping and switched via swipe
quote: To create a new shell, tap the screen with two fingers. To switch between active shells, swipe side to side.

text: Lets users create named Hosts that can be connected to using just the hostname
quote: Hosts: create hosts that can be accessed with only the hostname.

text: Generates SSH key pairs for password-less access to servers
quote: Keys: Create SSH key pairs for a more secure, password-less access to your servers.

text: Provides Smart Keys giving quick access to modifier keys (CTRL, ALT, ESC) for key combos
quote: Smart Keys provide special keys to use in your terminal session... Modifiers (i.e. CTRL ^, ALT ⌥, and ESC ⎋) for key combinations like CTRL+C.

text: Users can download and build Blink themselves from source to contribute to development
quote: If you would like to participate on its development, we would love to have you on board! There are two ways to collaborate with the project: you can download and build Blink yourself

text: Supports drag-and-drop text selection between Blink and other apps
quote: To start selection mode, Tap and drag. You can drag selections to other apps, or from other apps into Blink.

text: Supports SplitView multitasking alongside other apps
quote: We've incorporated SplitView, for those necessary Google searches and chats with coworkers.

text: Displays a full-resolution terminal on an external 4K display or Apple TV
quote: Connect your iPad Pro to a 4K display and get a full resolution, crystal clear terminal... Blink can be displayed on a remote Apple TV too!

text: Provides configurable keyboard shortcuts and custom modifier key presses
quote: Keyboard: add shortcuts, modifier keys and custom key presses.

text: Supports SSH tunnels (-L), ProxyCommand, and ssh-agent forwarding
quote: Including tunnels (-L), proxycommand and ssh-agent.

text: Bottom bar lets users create/close tabs, access saved command Snips, and toggle Lock and Geo settings
quote: In the bar you can: Create or Close a tab, access Snips, and toggle Lock and Geo.
